name: slide-deck-auditor
description: Configuration schema for slide-deck-auditor rules and thresholds

elevator_shaft.description: Flags column flex containers combining space-between with low content density causing dead space voids.

letterboxing_void.description: Flags image containers with black backgrounds and objectFit contain causing severe letterboxing borders.

semantic_color_inversion.description: Flags defense or mitigation sections using attack/danger red accent colors.

ai_fluff.description: Detects empty AI buzzwords, dramatic metaphors, and non-technical filler phrases.

typography_floor.description: Warns on text sizes falling below presentation projection standards (titles < 32px, body < 22px).
